`__rt_incref` does not follow SysV on x86_64: its body opens with `test rax, rax`, so it retains
the pointer in RAX. `__rt_array_to_hash_unique` and `__rt_hash_to_hash_unique` both loaded the
heap-backed payload into `rdi` before calling it. That assembles and links perfectly, retains
whatever was left in RAX — the result hash the helper is building — and leaves the real payload
unretained, so the element is freed with the source and read back as reused heap memory.
